short.zh: 找出两串字共同的部分

t.zh: 新的一章：比较两串文字。在两串字里按顺序都出现过的一串字，叫作它们的公共子序列。比如 ABCD 和 ACBD 里，A、B、D 就是一个。
t.en: A new chapter: comparing two strings. A sequence of letters that appears in order in both strings is called a common subsequence. In ABCD and ACBD, for example, A, B, D is one.

t.zh: 找公共子序列可以用连线：上下两个字相同，就连一根线。规则有三条：只能连相同的字；每个字最多连一根线；线不能交叉。
t.en: You can find a common subsequence by drawing lines: link a top letter to an equal bottom letter. There are three rules: only link equal letters; each letter takes at most one line; lines can’t cross.

t.zh: 为什么不能交叉？交叉说明这两个字在上面的顺序，和在下面的顺序是反的，读出来就不是同一串了。
t.en: Why can’t they cross? Crossing lines mean the two letters come in one order on top and the opposite order below, so reading them off wouldn’t give the same sequence.

t.zh: 连上的线越多，公共子序列就越长。目标：连出尽可能多的线。
t.en: The more lines, the longer the common subsequence. Your goal: draw as many lines as you can.

goal.zh: 两道题里，都连出最多的线。只能连相同的字，每个字最多连一根线，线不能交叉。
goal.en: In both puzzles, draw as many lines as possible. Only link equal letters, each letter takes at most one line, and lines can’t cross.

how.zh: 先点一个字，再点另一行里相同的字，就连上一根线。点一个已经连线的字，可以拆掉它的线。
how.en: Click a letter, then the same letter in the other row, to draw a line. Click a letter that already has a line to remove it.

hints.zh: 先别连 C。C 在上面排第一，在下面排第三，连了它，A 和 B 就都连不上了。
hints.en: Leave C alone for now. C is first on top but third below, so linking it blocks both A and B.

hints.zh: 目标是 4 根。B、C、B、A 是一种连法，B、D、A、B 是另一种。
hints.en: The target is 4 lines. B, C, B, A is one way; B, D, A, B is another.

body.zh: 你连出的线，从左往右读，就是两串字共有的一串，叫作公共子序列。最多能连几根，就是的长度。
body.en: Read from left to right, the lines you drew spell out a sequence both strings share: a common subsequence. The most lines you can draw is the length of the .

body.zh: 它的用途很多：比较两份文件改了哪里、比对两段 DNA 有多像、判断两份作业是不是抄的。
body.en: It has many uses: finding what changed between two versions of a file, measuring how alike two stretches of DNA are, telling whether one homework was copied from another.

note.zh: 公共子序列：两串字里，按顺序都出现的一串。连线不能交叉。
note.en: Common subsequence: letters that appear in order in both strings. The lines can’t cross.
